_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Split a role into AI and human work...

description:
Use this when the user wants to split a whole job into work AI can do now, work AI drafts for approval, and work that needs a person.
Best for: "which tasks of a bookkeeper need a person?", "split a software engineer role" or "job ad and two-week trial for a restaurant cook".
Returns: the O*NET occupation, each task tagged ai_now, ai_draft or human with rule and reason, a job-ad skeleton for the human tasks, and a two-week trial.
Input tips: send title, a job title such as "bookkeeper" or an O*NET-SOC code such as "15-1252.00". The title alone is best. Add description only when the title is vague; it widens the word match and can lower precision. Set occupations to 2 or 3 only to expand more than one match.
Not for: one named task (answer it plainly), judging a person, reading a resume, or legal or pay advice.
If status is no_match, ask for a clearer title or an O*NET code; do not invent tasks. If personal_data, ask again without contact details. If not_ready, retry later.

description.description: Optional pasted job description, for when the title is vague or missing. It widens the word match, so it can lower precision. Not stored. No names, emails or phone numbers.

occupations.description: How many matching occupations to expand, 1 to 3. Default 1. Further matches are listed as codes and titles only.

title.description: A job title, such as "bookkeeper", or an O*NET-SOC code in the form NN-NNNN.NN, such as "15-1252.00". Preferred input. No names, emails or phone numbers.

name: split_role

job_ad.description: Skeleton for the human pile. Empty responsibilities means do not hire for the listed tasks.

approve_before_sending.description: Tasks AI drafts for a person to approve.

matched_on.description: The O*NET title that matched, when a title matched.

model.description: Whether a language model broke a tie.

message.description: Set when status is not ok, with the next step. no_match: send a clearer title or an O*NET code. not_ready: retry later. personal_data: resend without names, emails or phone numbers.

note.description: Reminder that the split is a planning aid, not a decision about any person.

occupations.description: Matching occupations with each task tagged ai_now, ai_draft or human.

pile.description: ai_now, ai_draft (AI drafts, a person approves) or human.

rule.description: Id of the rubric rule that tagged the task.

type.description: O*NET task type, such as Core or Supplemental.

url.description: O*NET OnLine page for the occupation.

query.description: What was asked. The description text itself is never echoed.

code.description: The O*NET-SOC code read from the title, if any.

described.description: true when a description was sent.

rubric.description: The rubric rules, first match wins.

rubric_version.description: Version of the fixed rubric that tagged the tasks.

source.description: Data source and license to credit in the answer.

attribution.description: Credit line to include in the answer.

status.description: ok, or why there is no split.

title: Split a role into AI and human work
